description:
Job Responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain software components on current and future products. 

 Responsible for the development of the networking related features of the FortiSwitch product line. 

 Use AI efficiently to help development and testing

 Hands on in bug fixing current products. 

 Implement software features of high quality and on schedule. 

 Communicate effectively, both verbal and written.

  
 Job Requirements: 
 0-3 years’ experience in software engineering.

 Strong C/C++ and Linux experience is essential.

 Fundamental knowledge in networking

 Familiarity with socket programming.

 Knowledge of general QA procedures and methodologies as well as software development fundamentals.

 Knowledge of scripting languages: Shell and Python

 Must be authorized to work in the U.S without sponsorship

  
  
 Educational Requirements: 
 B.S. in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering; M.S. preferred.

  
 Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.  
 Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Earnings for this position are expected to be $110,000 - $180,000. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. 
 All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion 



 Fortinet makes possible a digital world that we can always trust through its mission to protect people, devices, and data everywhere.
